Module Type Stmt.
  #[local] Arguments wp_test [_ _ _ _] _ _ _.

weakest pre-condition for statements
  Section with_resolver.
    Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {σ : genv}.
    Variable (tu : translation_unit).

    #[local] Notation wp := (wp tu).
    #[local] Notation interp := (interp tu).
    #[local] Notation wp_initialize := (wp_initialize tu).
    #[local] Notation default_initialize := (default_initialize tu).

    Implicit Types Q : Kpred.

    Definition Kseq_inner (Q : Kpred -> mpred) (k : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | Normal => Q k
      | rt => k rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kseq_inner _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Kseq (Q : Kpred -> mpred) (k : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Kseq_inner Q k.
    #[global] Hint Opaque Kseq : typeclass_instances.

    Lemma Kseq_frame (Q1 Q2 : Kpred -> mpred) (k1 k2 : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) :
      ((Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -* Q1 k1 -* Q2 k2) |--
      (Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -*
      Kseq Q1 k1 rt -* Kseq Q2 k2 rt.
    Proof.
      iIntros "HQ Hk". destruct rt; cbn; try iExact "Hk".
      by iApply "HQ".
    Qed.

Kfree free Q destroys free, the variables of one declaration, on every exit from their scope and then continues as Q. The exception is a variable returned with named return value optimization (ReturnNRVO x p, see wp_return_nrvo): it *is* the returned object, so the destruction of the innermost variable named x is skipped and the return continues as an ordinary ReturnVal p. A declaration of other variables, made after x or in a nested block, destroys them as usual and propagates ReturnNRVO outward to the declaration of x.
    Definition Kfree_inner (free : FreeTemps) (Q : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | ReturnNRVO x p =>
          match FreeTemps.remove_var x free with
          | Some free => interp free (Q (ReturnVal p))
          | None => interp free (Q rt)
          end
      | _ => interp free (Q rt)
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kfree_inner _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Kfree (free : FreeTemps) (Q : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Kfree_inner free Q.
    #[global] Hint Opaque Kfree : typeclass_instances.

    Lemma Kfree_frame free Q Q' rt :
      (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |-- Kfree free Q rt -* Kfree free Q' rt.
    Proof.
      iIntros "X". destruct rt; cbn; try case_match.
      all: iApply interp_frame; iApply "X".
    Qed.

Attribute Evaluation


    (* NOTE: this assumes that attributes do not have a semantic
       impact on the code. There are some attributes, e.g. <<OMP::for>>
       that have a semantic impact on the code, but Clang chooses to
       represent these using different AST nodes. *)
    Axiom wp_attr : forall ρ attrs s Q,
        wp ρ s Q |-- wp ρ (Sattr attrs s) Q.

Expression Evaluation


    Axiom wp_expr : forall ρ e Q,
        |> wp_discard tu ρ e (fun free => interp free (Q Normal))
        |-- wp ρ (Sexpr e) Q.

Declarations


    (* This definition performs allocation of local variables.
     *)
    Definition wp_decl_var (ρ : region) (x : ident) (ty : type) (init : option Expr)
               (k : region -> FreeTemp -> epred)
      : mpred :=
      Forall (addr : ptr),
        let finish frees :=
            interp frees (k (Rbind x addr ρ) (FreeTemps.delete (Some x) ty addr))
        in
        match init with
        | Some init =>
            (* In C++ (and in C) the scope of the name begins immediately after
               the name is declared, before it is initialized.
               See <https://eel.is/c++draft/basic.scope.pdecl1> *)
            wp_initialize (Rbind x addr ρ) ty addr init finish
        | None => default_initialize ty addr finish
        end.

    Lemma wp_decl_var_frame : forall x ρ init ty (k k' : region -> FreeTemps -> epred),
        Forall a (b : _), k a b -* k' a b
        |-- wp_decl_var ρ x ty init k -* wp_decl_var ρ x ty init k'.
    Proof.
      rewrite /wp_decl_var; intros.
      iIntros "X Y" (addr); iSpecialize ("Y" $! addr); iRevert "Y".
      case_match;
        [ iApply wp_initialize_frame; [done|]
        | iApply default_initialize_frame; [done|] ];
        iIntros (?); iApply interp_frame; iApply "X".
    Qed.

    (* the variables declared in a destructing declaration must have initializers *)
    Record destructuring_declaration (d : VarDecl) : Prop := {}.

    Fixpoint wp_destructure (ρ_init : region) (ds : list BindingDecl)
      (ρ : region) (k : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) (free : FreeTemps) {struct ds} : mpred :=
      match ds with
      | nil => k ρ free
      | Bvar x ty init :: ds =>
          Forall p, wp_initialize ρ_init ty p init (fun free' => wp_destructure ρ_init ds (Rbind x p ρ) k (FreeTemps.delete None ty p >*> free' >*> free)%free)
      | Bbind x _ init :: ds =>
          wp_glval tu ρ_init init (fun p free' => wp_destructure ρ_init ds (Rbind x p ρ) k (free' >*> free)%free)
      end.

    Lemma wp_destructure_frame : forall ds ρ ρ_init m m' free,
        Forall a b, m a b -* m' a b
        |-- wp_destructure ρ_init ds ρ m free -* wp_destructure ρ_init ds ρ m' free.
    Proof.
      induction ds; simpl; intros.
      { iIntros "X"; iApply "X". }
      { iIntros "X H"; case_match.
        { iIntros (p); iSpecialize ("H" $! p); iRevert "H"; iApply wp_initialize_frame => //.
          iIntros (?); by iApply IHds. }
        { iRevert "H"; iApply wp_glval_frame => //.
          iIntros (??). by iApply IHds. } }
    Qed.

    (* static_initialized gn b is ownership of the initialization
       state of the global gn.

       We use atomic commits to access this state which requires the C++
       abstract machine to have access to some state (e.g. the boolean used
       in the implementation) to determine the current state. This is simple
       using an auth/frag construction where the abstract machine owns
       the auth and static_initialized is the frag.
     *)
    Variant init_state : Set :=
    | uninitialized | initializing | initialized.
    Parameter static_initialized : forall {σ : genv}, globname -> init_state -> mpred.
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_timeless {σ : genv} : Timeless2 static_initialized.
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_uninitialized_excl {σ : genv} nm : Exclusive0 (static_initialized nm uninitialized).
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_initializing_excl {σ : genv} nm : Exclusive0 (static_initialized nm initializing).
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_initialized_pers {σ : genv} nm : Persistent (static_initialized nm initialized).
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_initialized_affine {σ : genv} nm : Affine (static_initialized nm initialized).

    (* This instance allows proving
       
       static_initialized nm initializing ** static_initialized nm i |-- False
       indirectly through init_state_initiailized_excl
     *)
    #[global] Declare Instance init_state_agree nm : Agree1 (static_initialized nm).

wp_vla_bounds ρ es P evaluates es, the array bounds of a variably modified type, in order, and then continues as P. Each bound is evaluated as a full-expression, and its value must be an integer greater than zero: otherwise the behavior is undefined (C11 6.7.6.2p5).
    Fixpoint wp_vla_bounds (ρ : region) (es : list Expr) (P : mpred) : mpred :=
      match es with
      | nil => P
      | e :: es =>
          letI* v, free := wp_operand tu ρ e in
          interp free $
            Exists n : Z, [| v = Vint n |] ** [| (0 < n)%Z |] **
            wp_vla_bounds ρ es P
      end.

    Lemma wp_vla_bounds_frame ρ es (P P' : mpred) :
      (P -* P') |-- wp_vla_bounds ρ es P -* wp_vla_bounds ρ es P'.
    Proof.
      elim: es => [|e es IH] /=; first by iIntros "H".
      iIntros "HP". iApply wp_operand_frame; first done.
      iIntros (v free). iApply interp_frame.
      iIntros "(%n & % & % & H)". iExists n. do 2 (iSplit; first done).
      by iApply (IH with "HP").
    Qed.

    Definition wp_decl (ρ : region) (d : VarDecl) (k : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) : mpred :=
      match d with
      | Dvar x ty init => wp_decl_var ρ x ty init k
      | Ddecompose init x ds =>
        (* NOTE: the **declaration type** of the initializer *)
        let common_type := decltype_of_expr init in
        Forall common_p : ptr,
        (* unlike for variables (see wp_decl_var), the variables in a structured binding
           are not available in the initializer.
           See <https://eel.is/c++draft/dcl.struct.bind2> *)
        wp_initialize ρ common_type common_p init (fun free =>
           (* NOTE: free is used to deallocate temporaries generated in the execution of init.
              They are destroyed after the destructuring occurs, as in
              <https://eel.is/c++draft/class.temporary10>. In practice [free] is empty, because cpp2v wraps [init] in [Eandclean], which destroys them before the destructuring. *)
           wp_destructure (Rbind x common_p ρ) ds ρ (fun ρ f => interp free $ k ρ f) (FreeTemps.delete None common_type common_p))
      | Dinit ts nm ty init =>
        let k := k ρ in (* scope does not change *)
        let do_init k :=
            match init with
            | None => default_initialize ty (_global nm) k
            | Some init => wp_initialize ρ ty (_global nm) init k
            end
        in
        if ts then
          let Mouter := ⊤ ∖ ↑pred_ns in
          let Minner := ∅ in
          (* 1. atomically check the initialization state, mark it
                initializing if it is currently uninitialized.
             2. perform initialization (non-atomically)
             3. mark the state initialized.
           *)
          AC1 << ∀ i, static_initialized nm i >> @ Mouter , Minner
              << match i with
                 | uninitialized => static_initialized nm initializing
                 | initializing =>
                     (* the C++ thread waits unless the state is either initialized or uninitialized. *)
                     False
                 | _ => static_initialized nm i
                 end
               , COMM match i with
                      | uninitialized =>
                          letI* free := do_init in
                          AC1 << ∀ i, static_initialized nm i >> @ Mouter , Minner
                              << [| i = initializing |] **
                                 static_initialized nm initialized
                               , COMM k free >>
                      | _ => k FreeTemps.id
                      end >>
        else
          Exists i, static_initialized nm i **
          if i is uninitialized then
            do_init $ fun free => static_initialized nm initialized -* k free
          else k FreeTemps.id
      | Dvla_bounds es =>
        (* no name is bound, and no object is created *)
        wp_vla_bounds ρ es (k ρ FreeTemps.id)
      end%I.

    Lemma wp_decl_frame : forall ds ρ m m',
        Forall a b, m a b -* m' a b
        |-- wp_decl ρ ds m -* wp_decl ρ ds m'.
    Proof.
      destruct ds; simpl; intros.
      { iIntros "X". iApply wp_decl_var_frame. iIntros (?); eauto. }
      { iIntros "A X" (p); iSpecialize ("X" $! p); iRevert "X".
        iApply wp_initialize_frame; [done|].
        iIntros (?). iApply wp_destructure_frame.
        iIntros (??); iApply interp_frame; eauto. }
      { case_match.
        { iIntros "F H".
          iApply (atomic_commit1_ppost_wand with "H").
          iIntros "!>" ([ | | ]); eauto.
          case_match;
            first [ iApply wp_initialize_frame
                  | iApply default_initialize_frame ] => //;
            iIntros (?) "H";
            iApply (atomic_commit1_ppost_wand with "H");
            iIntros "!>" (?); eauto. }
        { iIntros "F H".
          iDestruct "H" as (i) "H"; iExists i.
          iDestruct "H" as "[$ H]".
          case_match; try solve [ iApply "F"; eauto ].
          iRevert "H".
          case_match;
            first [ iApply wp_initialize_frame
                  | iApply default_initialize_frame ] => //;
            iIntros (?) "X Y"; iApply "F"; iApply "X"; done. } }
      { iIntros "F". iApply wp_vla_bounds_frame. iApply "F". }
    Qed.

    (* wp_decls ρ_init ds ρ K evalutes the declarations in ds
    using the environment ρ_init and binds the declarations
    in ρ (which it passes to K) *)
    Fixpoint wp_decls_def (ρ : region) (ds : list VarDecl)
      (k : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) : mpred :=
      match ds with
      | nil => |={⊤}=> k ρ FreeTemps.id
      | d :: ds => |={⊤}=> |> wp_decl ρ d (fun ρ free => wp_decls_def ρ ds (fun ρ free' => k ρ (free' >*> free)%free))
      end.
    Definition wp_decls_aux : seal (@wp_decls_def). Proof. by eexists. Qed.
    Definition wp_decls := wp_decls_aux.(unseal).
    Definition wp_decls_eq : @wp_decls = _ := wp_decls_aux.(seal_eq).

    Lemma wp_decls_frame : forall ds ρ (Q Q' : region -> FreeTemps -> epred),
        Forall a (b : _), Q a b -* Q' a b
        |-- wp_decls ρ ds Q -* wp_decls ρ ds Q'.
    Proof.
      rewrite wp_decls_eq.
      induction ds; simpl; intros.
      - iIntros "a H". iMod "H". iIntros "!>". iRevert "H".
        iApply "a".
      - iIntros "a b". iMod "b". iIntros "!> !>". iRevert "b".
        iApply wp_decl_frame.
        iIntros (??). iApply IHds. iIntros (??) "X". by iApply "a".
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_decls_shift ρ ds (Q : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) :
      (|={top}=> wp_decls ρ ds (funI ρ free => |={top}=> Q ρ free)) |--
      wp_decls ρ ds Q.
    Proof.
      rewrite wp_decls_eq /=.
      elim: ds ρ Q => [|d ds IH] ρ Q /=.
      - by iIntros ">>H".
      - iIntros ">>H !> !>".
        iApply (wp_decl_frame with "[] H").
        iIntros (??) "H". iApply IH. by iModIntro.
    Qed.

    Lemma fupd_wp_decls ρ ds (Q : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) :
      (|={top}=> wp_decls ρ ds Q) |-- wp_decls ρ ds Q.
    Proof.
      rewrite -{2}wp_decls_shift; f_equiv.
      iApply wp_decls_frame. by iIntros "* $".
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_decls_fupd ρ ds (Q : region -> FreeTemps -> epred) :
      wp_decls ρ ds (funI ρ free => |={top}=> Q ρ free) |--
      wp_decls ρ ds Q.
    Proof. iIntros "H". iApply wp_decls_shift. by iModIntro. Qed.

Blocks

Labels and goto

A goto l; exits its statement with Goto l (see wp_goto).
Forward. Each block that receives Goto l from one of its statements looks for a statement labeled l among the statements that follow it, stopping at the next declaration (jump_to): if it finds one, execution resumes there, in the same scope; otherwise Goto l leaves the block, whose Kfree continuations destroy its automatic variables, as for return.
Backward. A block also remembers the labeled statements it has gone past, whether it ran them or a forward jump skipped them: its continuation sends a Goto l for a label l of such a statement to the block from that statement on, run again with the continuation it had there (Klabels). This is an unrolling rule, like wp_while_unroll; the rule with an invariant for the label, wp_block_label_inv, is derived from it by Löb induction. The Goto l reaches that continuation from the statements after the label, from statements nested in them, and from the scope of the declarations after the label, through the Kfree of each one: the variables destroyed are exactly those active at the goto and not at the label (<https://eel.is/c++draft/stmt.dcl2>), and a declaration between the label and the <> is run again when control reaches it. This covers jumps forward to a later statement of the same block or of an enclosing block that do not skip a declaration, and jumps backward to a statement of the same block or of an enclosing one. Jumps into a nested statement and jumps forward past a declaration reach the function boundary, where [Goto] is [False]; so does a jump backward in a <> body to a label before the <> that was entered, since the body is run from that <> on ([wp_switch]). A labeled declaration is a declaration ([stmt_decl]) and can be a target in both directions. As for loops, these rules are for partial correctness: <> satisfies any postcondition. Labels are identified by their names: the rules assume that a function body defines each label name once, so that the label found is the target. Standard C++ guarantees it (__label__ L;) are the exception. cpp2v rejects their declarations, and the support report checks that no function body defines a label name twice (walk.labels_unique in syntax/supported.v).
has_label l s: s carries the label l, possibly among others.
    Fixpoint has_label (l : ident) (s : Stmt) : bool :=
      match s with
      | Slabeled l' s => bool_decide (l = l') || has_label l s
      | _ => false
      end.

find_label k l ss is Some (k ss') where ss' is the suffix of ss that starts with the statement labeled l, provided no declaration (is_decl, labeled or not) comes before it. A labeled declaration is a target for its own labels: jumping to it skips no declaration, since its variables are not active yet.
    Definition find_label {A} (k : list Stmt -> A) (l : ident) : list Stmt -> option A :=
      fix go ss :=
      match ss with
      | nil => None
      | s :: ss' =>
          if has_label l s then Some (k ss)
          else if is_decl s then None else go ss'
      end.

    Lemma find_label_nil {A} (k : list Stmt -> A) l : find_label k l [] = None.
    Proof. done. Qed.

    Lemma find_label_cons {A} (k : list Stmt -> A) l s ss :
      find_label k l (s :: ss) =
      if has_label l s then Some (k (s :: ss))
      else if is_decl s then None else find_label k l ss.
    Proof. done. Qed.

    Lemma find_label_fmap {A} (k : list Stmt -> A) l ss :
      find_label k l ss = k <$> find_label id l ss.
    Proof.
      elim: ss => [|s ss IH] //. rewrite !find_label_cons IH.
      by destruct (has_label l s), (is_decl s).
    Qed.

    Lemma find_label_length l ss ss' :
      find_label id l ss = Some ss' -> length ss' <= length ss.
    Proof.
      elim: ss => [|s ss IH] //. rewrite find_label_cons.
      destruct (has_label l s); first by move=> [<-].
      destruct (is_decl s) => //. move=> /IH /=. lia.
    Qed.

head_labels s: the labels of the statement s, outermost first.
    Fixpoint head_labels (s : Stmt) : list ident :=
      match s with
      | Slabeled l s => l :: head_labels s
      | _ => nil
      end.

    Definition is_label (l : ident) (ls : list ident) : bool :=
      existsb (fun l' => bool_decide (l = l')) ls.

    Lemma has_label_head_labels l s : has_label l s = is_label l (head_labels s).
    Proof. induction s => //=. by rewrite IHs. Qed.

Klabel ls P Q: a goto to one of the labels ls continues as P; every other exit continues as Q.
    Definition Klabel_inner (ls : list ident) (P : mpred) (Q : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | Goto l => if is_label l ls then P else Q rt
      | rt => Q rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Klabel_inner _ _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Klabel (ls : list ident) (P : mpred) (Q : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Klabel_inner ls P Q.
    #[global] Hint Opaque Klabel : typeclass_instances.

    Lemma Klabel_frame ls (P P' : mpred) (Q Q' : Kpred) rt :
      (P -* P') //\\ (Forall rt : ReturnType, Q rt -* Q' rt) |--
      Klabel ls P Q rt -* Klabel ls P' Q' rt.
    Proof.
      destruct rt; cbn; try by rewrite bi.and_elim_r; iIntros "H"; iApply "H".
      case: (is_label l ls); first by rewrite bi.and_elim_l.
      rewrite bi.and_elim_r; iIntros "H"; iApply "H".
    Qed.

Kagain ls B Q is Klabel ls (B Q) Q: a goto to one of ls runs B, the block from the statement labeled ls on, again, with the continuation Q that the block had at that statement.
    Definition Kagain (ls : list ident) (B : Kpred -> mpred) (Q : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Klabel_inner ls (B Q) Q.
    #[global] Hint Opaque Kagain : typeclass_instances.

    Lemma Kagain_eq ls (B : Kpred -> mpred) Q : Kagain ls B Q = Klabel ls (B Q) Q.
    Proof. done. Qed.

Klabels B s Q is the continuation of a block that has gone past its statement s, where B runs the block from s on and Q is the continuation the block had at s: the labels of s, if any, have become targets (Kagain).
    Definition Klabels (B : Kpred -> mpred) (s : Stmt) (Q : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      match head_labels s with
      | nil => Q
      | ls => Kagain ls B Q
      end.

    Lemma Klabels_frame (B B' : Kpred -> mpred) s (Q Q' : Kpred) rt :
      (B Q -* B' Q') //\\ (Forall rt : ReturnType, Q rt -* Q' rt) |--
      Klabels B s Q rt -* Klabels B' s Q' rt.
    Proof.
      rewrite /Klabels. destruct (head_labels s) as [|l ls].
      - rewrite bi.and_elim_r. iIntros "H"; iApply "H".
      - rewrite !Kagain_eq. apply Klabel_frame.
    Qed.

jump_to B l ss k is where a goto l continues when the statements ss follow it in its block, and B ss' k' runs the statements ss' of that block: at the first statement of ss labeled l, provided no declaration (is_decl, labeled or not) comes before it. The labels of the statements that the jump skips become targets for later jumps, as if the statements had been run (Klabels).
    Definition jump_to (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) (l : ident)
        : list Stmt -> Kpred -> option mpred :=
      fix go ss k :=
      match ss with
      | nil => None
      | s :: ss' =>
          if has_label l s then Some (B ss k)
          else if is_decl s then None else go ss' (Klabels (B ss) s k)
      end.

    Lemma jump_to_cons (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) l s ss k :
      jump_to B l (s :: ss) k =
      if has_label l s then Some (B (s :: ss) k)
      else if is_decl s then None else jump_to B l ss (Klabels (B (s :: ss)) s k).
    Proof. done. Qed.

skipped B l ss k: the continuation at the statement labeled l, after a jump from before ss.
    Fixpoint skipped (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) (l : ident) (ss : list Stmt)
        (k : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      match ss with
      | nil => k
      | s :: ss' =>
          if has_label l s then k else skipped B l ss' (Klabels (B ss) s k)
      end.

    Lemma jump_to_find (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) l ss k :
      jump_to B l ss k = (fun ss' => B ss' (skipped B l ss k)) <$> find_label id l ss.
    Proof.
      elim: ss k => [|s ss IH] k //. rewrite jump_to_cons find_label_cons. cbn [skipped].
      destruct (has_label l s) => //. destruct (is_decl s) => //.
    Qed.

    Lemma skipped_here (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) l s ss k :
      skipped B l (Slabeled l s :: ss) k = k.
    Proof. by rewrite /= bool_decide_true. Qed.

Kblock B ss k continues a statement followed by ss in a block; B ss' k' runs the statements ss' of that block (it is wp_block ρ). Normal completion runs ss; Goto l runs the suffix of ss labeled l, if any (jump_to).
    Definition Kblock_inner (next : mpred) (jump : ident -> option mpred)
        (k : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | Normal => next
      | Goto l =>
          match jump l with
          | Some P => P
          | None => k rt
          end
      | rt => k rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kblock_inner _ _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Kblock (B : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) (ss : list Stmt) (k : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Kblock_inner (B ss k) (fun l => jump_to B l ss k) k.
    #[global] Hint Opaque Kblock : typeclass_instances.

    Lemma skipped_frame (B1 B2 : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) l (ss0 ss : list Stmt)
        (k1 k2 : Kpred) :
      length ss <= length ss0 ->
      □ (Forall ss' (k1 k2 : Kpred), [| length ss' <= length ss0 |] -*
         (Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -* B1 ss' k1 -* B2 ss' k2) |--
      (Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -*
      Forall rt : ReturnType, skipped B1 l ss k1 rt -* skipped B2 l ss k2 rt.
    Proof.
      elim: ss k1 k2 => [|s ss IH] k1 k2 Hlen; first by iIntros "_ H".
      cbn [skipped]. iIntros "#HB Hk". destruct (has_label l s); first iExact "Hk".
      iApply (IH with "HB"); first by cbn in Hlen; lia.
      iIntros (rt). iApply Klabels_frame.
      iSplit; [iApply ("HB" with "[//]")|]; iExact "Hk".
    Qed.

    Lemma Kblock_frame (B1 B2 : list Stmt -> Kpred -> mpred) ss (k1 k2 : Kpred) rt :
      □ (Forall ss' (k1 k2 : Kpred), [| length ss' <= length ss |] -*
         (Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -* B1 ss' k1 -* B2 ss' k2) |--
      (Forall rt : ReturnType, k1 rt -* k2 rt) -*
      Kblock B1 ss k1 rt -* Kblock B2 ss k2 rt.
    Proof.
      iIntros "#HB Hk". destruct rt; cbn; try iExact "Hk".
      - by iApply ("HB" with "[//] Hk").
      - rewrite !jump_to_find.
        destruct (find_label id l ss) as [ss'|] eqn:Hf; cbn; last iExact "Hk".
        iApply ("HB" $! ss' with "[%]"); first exact: find_label_length.
        by iApply (skipped_frame with "HB Hk").
    Qed.

    Lemma Kblock_normal B ss k : Kblock B ss k Normal = B ss k.
    Proof. done. Qed.

    Lemma Kblock_goto_jump B ss k l :
      Kblock B ss k (Goto l) =
      match jump_to B l ss k with
      | Some P => P
      | None => k (Goto l)
      end.
    Proof. done. Qed.

    Lemma Kblock_goto B ss k l :
      Kblock B ss k (Goto l) =
      match find_label id l ss with
      | Some ss' => B ss' (skipped B l ss k)
      | None => k (Goto l)
      end.
    Proof. rewrite /Kblock /KP /= jump_to_find. by case: (find_label id l ss). Qed.

    Lemma find_label_here l s ss :
      find_label id l (Slabeled l s :: ss) = Some (Slabeled l s :: ss).
    Proof. by rewrite find_label_cons /= bool_decide_true. Qed.

    Fixpoint wp_block_def (ρ : region) (ss : list Stmt) (Q : Kpred) : mpred :=
      match ss with
      | nil => |={top}=> |> |={top}=> Q Normal
      | s :: ss' =>
        (* From s on, a <<goto>> to a label of s runs this block, ss,
           again. The block cannot refer to itself at ss, so it does so
           through wp_seq, as wp_while_unroll names its loop. *)
        let Q := Klabels (wp ρ (Sseq ss)) s Q in
        (* A declaration, labeled or not (stmt_decl), scopes the rest of the
           block. *)
        match stmt_decl s with
        | Some ds =>
          wp_decls ρ ds (funI ρ free =>
                           |={top}=> |> |={top}=> wp_block_def ρ ss' (Kfree free Q))
        | None =>
          |={top}=> |> |={top}=> wp ρ s
            (* Kblock (wp_block_def ρ) ss' (|={top}=> Q), with jump_to
               inlined so that the recursive calls are on subterms of ss. *)
            (KP $ Kblock_inner (wp_block_def ρ ss' (|={top}=> Q))
               (fun l =>
                  (fix go ss k :=
                   match ss with
                   | nil => None
                   | s :: ss' =>
                       if has_label l s then Some (wp_block_def ρ ss k)
                       else if is_decl s then None
                       else go ss' (Klabels (wp_block_def ρ ss) s k)
                   end) ss' (|={top}=> Q))
               (|={top}=> Q))
        end
      end%I.
    Definition wp_block_aux : seal (@wp_block_def). Proof. by eexists. Qed.
    Definition wp_block := wp_block_aux.(unseal).
    Definition wp_block_eq : @wp_block = _ := wp_block_aux.(seal_eq).

wp_block_head ρ s ss Q: the statement s, then the rest ss of its block.
    Definition wp_block_head (ρ : region) (s : Stmt) (ss : list Stmt) (Q : Kpred) : mpred :=
      match stmt_decl s with
      | Some ds =>
        wp_decls ρ ds (funI ρ free =>
                         |={top}=> |> |={top}=> wp_block ρ ss (Kfree free Q))
      | None =>
        |={top}=> |> |={top}=> wp ρ s (Kblock (wp_block ρ) ss (|={top}=> Q))
      end%I.

    (* Show wp_block satisfies the fixpoint equation. *)
    Lemma wp_block_unfold (ρ : region) (ss : list Stmt) (Q : Kpred) :
      wp_block ρ ss Q =
      (match ss with
      | nil => |={top}=> |> |={top}=> Q Normal
      | s :: ss' => wp_block_head ρ s ss' (Klabels (wp ρ (Sseq ss)) s Q)
      end)%I.
    Proof. rewrite /wp_block_head !wp_block_eq; by destruct ss. Qed.

    #[local] Lemma wp_block_head_frame_aux ρ s ss Q Q' :
      (forall ss' ρ Q Q', length ss' <= length ss ->
         (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |-- wp_block ρ ss' Q -* wp_block ρ ss' Q') ->
      (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |-- wp_block_head ρ s ss Q -* wp_block_head ρ s ss Q'.
    Proof.
      intros IH. rewrite /wp_block_head. iIntros "X". destruct (stmt_decl s) as [ds|].
      - iApply wp_decls_frame.
        iIntros (??) ">H !> !>". iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (IH with "[X] H"); first done. iIntros (?).
        iApply Kfree_frame. iApply "X".
      - iIntros ">H !> !>". iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (wp_frame with "[X] H"); first by reflexivity.
        iAssert (Forall rt, (|={⊤}=> Q) rt -* (|={⊤}=> Q') rt)%I with "[X]" as "X". {
          setoid_rewrite monPred_at_fupd.
          iIntros (?) ">H !>". by iApply "X".
        }
        iIntros (rt). iApply (Kblock_frame with "[] X").
        iIntros "!>" (ss' k1 k2 Hss') "X H". by iApply (IH with "X H").
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_block_frame : forall ss ρ (Q Q' : Kpred),
        (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt)
        |-- wp_block ρ ss Q -* wp_block ρ ss Q'.
    Proof.
      (* Strong induction: a goto continues with a suffix of the block. *)
      intros ss. remember (length ss) as n eqn:Hn. revert ss Hn.
      induction n as [n IH] using lt_wf_ind => ss Hn ρ Q Q'.
      destruct ss as [|s ss]. {
        rewrite !wp_block_unfold.
        by iIntros "Hcnt HQ"; iMod "HQ"; iApply "Hcnt".
      }
      cbn in Hn. rewrite !wp_block_unfold. iIntros "X".
      iApply wp_block_head_frame_aux.
      { intros ss' ??? Hle. apply (IH (length ss')); [lia|done]. }
      iIntros (rt). iApply Klabels_frame.
      iSplit; [iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity|]; iExact "X".
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_block_head_frame ρ s ss (Q Q' : Kpred) :
      (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |-- wp_block_head ρ s ss Q -* wp_block_head ρ s ss Q'.
    Proof. apply wp_block_head_frame_aux. intros. apply wp_block_frame. Qed.

As wp_block_head_frame, when the continuations are only related later: a block takes a step before each of its statements.
    Lemma wp_block_head_later_frame ρ s ss (Q Q' : Kpred) :
      ▷ (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |-- wp_block_head ρ s ss Q -* wp_block_head ρ s ss Q'.
    Proof.
      rewrite /wp_block_head. iIntros "X". destruct (stmt_decl s) as [ds|].
      - iApply wp_decls_frame. iIntros (??) ">H !> !>". iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (wp_block_frame with "[X] H"). iIntros (?).
        iApply Kfree_frame. iApply "X".
      - iIntros ">H !> !>". iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (wp_frame with "[X] H"); first by reflexivity.
        iIntros (rt). iApply (Kblock_frame with "[] [X]").
        + iIntros "!>" (????). iApply wp_block_frame.
        + iIntros (?). rewrite !monPred_at_fupd. iIntros ">H !>". by iApply "X".
    Qed.

    #[local] Lemma wp_block_head_shift_aux ρ s ss (Q : Kpred) :
      (forall ρ Q, (|={top}=> wp_block ρ ss (|={top}=> Q)) |-- wp_block ρ ss Q) ->
      (|={top}=> wp_block_head ρ s ss (|={top}=> Q)) |-- wp_block_head ρ s ss Q.
    Proof.
      intros IH. rewrite /wp_block_head. destruct (stmt_decl s) as [ds|].
      - iIntros "H". iApply wp_decls_shift. iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (wp_decls_frame with "[] H"); iIntros (??) ">H !> !> !> !>".
        iApply IH. iMod "H"; iModIntro.
        iApply (wp_block_frame with "[] H"); iIntros (rt) "H !>".
        destruct rt; cbn; try case_match.
        all: rewrite monPred_at_fupd; iApply (interp_shift with "H").
      - iIntros ">>H !> !> !>". iMod "H". iApply (wp_frame with "[] H"). done.
        iIntros (?) "H".
        iApply (Kblock_frame with "[] [] H").
        { iIntros "!>" (????). iApply wp_block_frame. }
        iIntros (?) "H". by rewrite fupd_idemp.
    Qed.

    #[local] Lemma Klabels_fupd ρ ss s (Q : Kpred) rt :
      Klabels (wp ρ (Sseq ss)) s (|={top}=> Q) rt |--
      (|={top}=> Klabels (wp ρ (Sseq ss)) s Q) rt.
    Proof.
      rewrite /Klabels. destruct (head_labels s) as [|l ls]; first done.
      rewrite monPred_at_fupd.
      destruct rt; cbn -[is_label]; rewrite ?monPred_at_fupd //.
      case: (is_label _ _); rewrite ?monPred_at_fupd //.
      iIntros "H !>". by iApply wp_fupd.
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_block_shift ρ ds (Q : Kpred) :
      (|={top}=> wp_block ρ ds (|={top}=> Q)) |--
      wp_block ρ ds Q.
    Proof.
      elim: ds ρ Q => [|d ds IH] ρ Q; rewrite !wp_block_unfold.
      { iIntros ">>H !> !> /=". by iMod "H" as ">$". }
      iIntros "H". iApply wp_block_head_shift_aux; first done.
      iMod "H"; iModIntro. iApply (wp_block_head_frame with "[] H").
      iIntros (rt). iApply Klabels_fupd.
    Qed.

    Lemma fupd_wp_block ρ ds Q :
      (|={top}=> wp_block ρ ds Q) |-- wp_block ρ ds Q.
    Proof.
      rewrite -{2}wp_block_shift; f_equiv.
      iApply wp_block_frame. by iIntros "* $".
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_block_fupd ρ ds Q :
      wp_block ρ ds (|={top}=> Q) |--
      wp_block ρ ds Q.
    Proof. iIntros "H". iApply wp_block_shift. by iModIntro. Qed.

    #[global] Instance wp_block_mono ρ ls : Proper (bi_entails ==> bi_entails) (wp_block ρ ls).
    Proof.
      move => x y [Hxy].
      apply bi.wand_entails.
      rewrite -wp_block_frame.
      apply bi.forall_intro => ?.
      by apply bi.entails_wand.
    Qed.
    #[global] Instance wp_block_flip_mono ρ ls : Proper (flip bi_entails ==> flip bi_entails) (wp_block ρ ls).
    Proof. solve_proper. Qed.
    #[global] Instance wp_block_proper ρ ls : Proper (equiv ==> equiv) (wp_block ρ ls).
    Proof.
      move => x y /bi.equiv_entails []
           => /wp_block_mono Hxy
           => /wp_block_mono Hyx.
      by split'.
    Qed.

    (* proof mode *)
    #[global] Instance elim_modal_fupd_wp_block p P ρ body Q :
      ElimModal True p false (|={top}=> P) P (wp_block ρ body Q) (wp_block ρ body Q).
    Proof.
      rewrite /ElimModal. rewrite bi.intuitionistically_if_elim/=.
      by rewrite fupd_frame_r bi.wand_elim_r fupd_wp_block.
    Qed.
    #[global] Instance elim_modal_bupd_wp_lval p P Q ρ body :
      ElimModal True p false (|==> P) P (wp_block ρ body Q) (wp_block ρ body Q).
    Proof.
      rewrite /ElimModal (bupd_fupd top). exact: elim_modal_fupd_wp_block.
    Qed.
    #[global] Instance add_modal_fupd_wp_lval P Q ρ body :
      AddModal (|={top}=> P) P (wp_block ρ body Q).
    Proof.
      rewrite/AddModal. by rewrite fupd_frame_r bi.wand_elim_r fupd_wp_block.
    Qed.

    Axiom wp_seq : forall ρ Q ss,
        wp_block ρ ss Q |-- wp ρ (Sseq ss) Q.

Derived rules for a labeled statement heading a block

s is labeled and heads a block; ss follows it. In each rule, a goto to a label of s from s or from what follows it continues as the first argument of Klabel.
Unrolling: the jump runs the block from s again.
    Lemma wp_block_label_unroll ρ s ss Q :
      head_labels s <> nil ->
      wp_block_head ρ s ss (Klabel (head_labels s) (wp_block ρ (s :: ss) Q) Q)
      |-- wp_block ρ (s :: ss) Q.
    Proof.
      intros Hls.
      trans (wp_block_head ρ s ss (Klabels (wp ρ (Sseq (s :: ss))) s Q));
        last by rewrite wp_block_unfold.
      rewrite /Klabels. destruct (head_labels s) as [|l ls]; first done.
      rewrite Kagain_eq. iIntros "H". iApply (wp_block_head_frame with "[] H").
      iIntros (rt). iApply Klabel_frame. iSplit; last by iIntros (?) "$".
      iApply wp_seq.
    Qed.

No jump comes back.
    Lemma wp_block_label_once ρ s ss Q :
      head_labels s <> nil ->
      wp_block_head ρ s ss (Klabel (head_labels s) False Q)
      |-- wp_block ρ (s :: ss) Q.
    Proof.
      intros Hls. rewrite -wp_block_label_unroll //.
      iIntros "H". iApply (wp_block_head_frame with "[] H").
      iIntros (rt). iApply Klabel_frame. iSplit; last by iIntros (?) "$".
      by iIntros "[]".
    Qed.

The invariant rule, by Löb induction, as wp_while_inv for while: P holds on reaching s, and the jump has to re-establish it. The later that the induction needs comes from the step a block takes before each statement (wp_block_head_later_frame) and, for the user, from wp_goto.
    Lemma wp_block_label_inv (P : mpred) ρ s ss Q :
      head_labels s <> nil ->
      P ** □ (P -* wp_block_head ρ s ss (Klabel (head_labels s) P Q))
      |-- wp_block ρ (s :: ss) Q.
    Proof.
      intros Hls. iIntros "[P #H]".
      iAssert (□ (P -* wp_block ρ (s :: ss) Q))%I with "[]" as "#PW"; last by iApply "PW".
      iLöb as "IH". iIntros "!> P". iApply wp_block_label_unroll; first done.
      iApply (wp_block_head_later_frame with "[] (H P)").
      iIntros "!>" (rt). iApply Klabel_frame. iSplit; last by iIntros (?) "$".
      iApply "IH".
    Qed.

if


    Definition pre_stmt (init : option Stmt) (decl : option VarDecl) : option (list Stmt) :=
      match init , decl with
      | None , None => None
      | Some s , None => Some [s]
      | None , Some vd => Some [Sdecl [vd]]
| Some s , Some vd => Some [s; Sdecl [vd]]
end.

    Axiom wp_if : forall ρ init decl e thn els Q,
        match pre_stmt init decl with
        | None =>
        |> letI* c , free := Unfold WPE.wp_test (wp_test tu ρ e) in
           interp free $
             if c
             then wp ρ thn Q
             else wp ρ els Q
        | Some ss =>
            wp ρ (Sseq (ss ++ [Sif None None e thn els])) Q
        end
      |-- wp ρ (Sif init decl e thn els) Q.

    (* The loops are phrased using 1-step unfoldings and invariant rules are
       proved using Löb induction.

       C++ (and C) allow optimizing away certain infinite loops,
       e.g. <<while (1);>> can be optimized to <<;>>.
       These loop rules are not sound for use with compilations that use this
       optimization.
     *)

    (* loop with invariant `I` *)
    Definition Kloop_inner (I : mpred) (Q : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | Break => Q Normal
      | Normal | Continue => I
      | rt => Q rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kloop_inner _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Kloop (I : mpred) (Q : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Kloop_inner I Q.

while


    Definition while_unroll ρ decl test body :=
      wp ρ (Sif None decl test body Sbreak).

    Axiom wp_while_unroll : forall ρ decl test body Q,
            while_unroll ρ decl test body (Kloop (|> wp ρ (Swhile decl test body) Q) Q)
        |-- wp ρ (Swhile decl test body) Q.

    Theorem wp_while_inv I : forall ρ decl test body Q,
        I |-- while_unroll ρ decl test body (Kloop (|> I) Q) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Swhile decl test body) Q.
    Proof.
      intros.
      iLöb as "IH".
      iIntros "I".
      iApply wp_while_unroll.
      rewrite {2}H.
      iRevert "I"; iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity.
      iIntros (rt) "K"; destruct rt; simpl; eauto.
      - iApply "IH"; eauto.
      - iApply "IH"; eauto.
    Qed.

    (* for backwards compatibility *)
    Lemma wp_while_inv_nolater I : forall ρ decl test body Q,
        I |-- Unfold while_unroll (while_unroll ρ decl test body (Kloop I Q)) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Swhile decl test body) Q.
    Proof.
      intros.
      iApply wp_while_inv.
      rewrite {1}H.
      iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity.
      iIntros (rt); destruct rt; simpl; eauto.
    Qed.

for

    Definition Kpost_inner I Q (rt : ReturnType) :=
      match rt with
      | Normal | Continue => I
      | _ => Q rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kpost_inner _ _ !rt /.

    Definition Kpost I Q :=
      KP $ Kpost_inner I Q.

One iteration with the condition binding, if any, already in scope.
    Definition for_body_unroll (ρ : region) (test incr : option Expr)
        (body : Stmt) (Q : Kpred) : mpred :=
      let Kinc :=
        Kpost (match incr with
               | None => Q Normal
               | Some incr => wp_discard tu ρ incr (fun free => interp free $ Q Normal)
               end) Q
      in
      match test with
      | None => wp ρ body
      | Some test => wp ρ (Sif None None test body Sbreak)
      end Kinc.

A condition declaration is initialized for every test. Its binding encloses both body and increment. Normal completion and continue run the increment before its cleanup; a false test, break, or return clean it up without incrementing.
    Definition for_unroll (ρ : region) (decl : option VarDecl)
        (test incr : option Expr) (body : Stmt) (Q : Kpred) : mpred :=
      match decl with
      | None => for_body_unroll ρ test incr body Q
      | Some decl => wp_decl ρ decl (fun ρ' free =>
          for_body_unroll ρ' test incr body (Kfree free Q))
      end.

    Lemma for_body_unroll_frame ρ test incr body Q Q' :
        (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |--
        for_body_unroll ρ test incr body Q -* for_body_unroll ρ test incr body Q'.
    Proof.
      rewrite /for_body_unroll. iIntros "HQ".
      destruct test; simpl; (iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity).
      all: iIntros (rt); destruct rt; simpl; try iApply "HQ".
      all: destruct incr; simpl; last iApply "HQ".
      all: iApply wp_discard_frame; first reflexivity.
      all: iIntros (free); iApply interp_frame; iApply "HQ".
    Qed.

    Lemma for_unroll_frame ρ decl test incr body Q Q' :
        (Forall rt, Q rt -* Q' rt) |--
        for_unroll ρ decl test incr body Q -* for_unroll ρ decl test incr body Q'.
    Proof.
      rewrite /for_unroll. iIntros "HQ". destruct decl.
      - iApply wp_decl_frame. iIntros (ρ' free).
        iApply for_body_unroll_frame. iIntros (rt).
        iApply Kfree_frame. iApply "HQ".
      - iApply for_body_unroll_frame. iApply "HQ".
    Qed.

    Axiom wp_for_unroll : forall ρ decl test incr body Q,
        for_unroll ρ decl test incr body
          (Kloop (|> wp ρ (Sfor None decl test incr body) Q) Q)
        |-- wp ρ (Sfor None decl test incr body) Q.

    Theorem wp_for_inv I : forall ρ decl test incr body Q,
        I |-- for_unroll ρ decl test incr body (Kloop (|> I) Q) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Sfor None decl test incr body) Q.
    Proof.
      intros * H. iLöb as "IH". iIntros "I".
      iApply wp_for_unroll. rewrite {2}H.
      iRevert "I". iApply for_unroll_frame.
      iIntros (rt); destruct rt; simpl; eauto.
      all: iIntros "I !>"; iApply "IH"; eauto.
    Qed.

    (* for backwards compatibility *)
    Lemma wp_for_inv_nolater I : forall ρ decl test incr body Q,
        I |-- Unfold for_unroll (for_unroll ρ decl test incr body (Kloop (|> I) Q)) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Sfor None decl test incr body) Q.
    Proof. intros * H. apply wp_for_inv. exact H. Qed.

The initializer runs once, in the scope enclosing all iterations.
    Axiom wp_for_init : forall ρ init decl test incr body Q,
        wp ρ (Sseq [init; Sfor None decl test incr body]) Q
        |-- wp ρ (Sfor (Some init) decl test incr body) Q.

do


    Definition do_unroll ρ body test (Q : Kpred) :=
      wp ρ body (Kpost (Unfold WPE.wp_test (wp_test tu ρ test (fun c free => interp free $ if c then Q Continue else Q Break))) Q).

    Axiom wp_do_unroll : forall ρ body test Q,
            do_unroll ρ body test (Kloop (|> wp ρ (Sdo body test) Q) Q)
        |-- wp ρ (Sdo body test) Q.

    Theorem wp_do_inv I : forall ρ body test Q,
        I |-- do_unroll ρ body test (Kloop (|> I) Q) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Sdo body test) Q.
    Proof.
      intros.
      iLöb as "IH".
      iIntros "I".
      iApply wp_do_unroll.
      rewrite {2}H /do_unroll.
      iRevert "I"; iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity.
      iIntros (rt) "K"; destruct rt; simpl; eauto.
      { iRevert "K"; iApply wp_test_frame; iIntros (??).
        iApply interp_frame; case_match; eauto.
        iIntros "? !>"; iApply "IH"; eauto. }
      { iRevert "K"; iApply wp_test_frame; iIntros (??).
        iApply interp_frame; case_match; eauto.
        iIntros "? !>"; iApply "IH"; eauto. }
    Qed.

    Lemma wp_do_inv_nolater I : forall ρ body test Q,
        I |-- Unfold do_unroll (do_unroll ρ body test (Kloop I Q)) ->
        I |-- wp ρ (Sdo body test) Q.
    Proof.
      intros.
      apply wp_do_inv.
      rewrite {1}H /do_unroll.
      iIntros "X"; iRevert "X".
      iApply wp_frame; first reflexivity.
      iIntros (rt); destruct rt; simpl; eauto.
      all: iApply wp_test_frame; iIntros (??).
      all: iApply interp_frame; case_match; eauto.
    Qed.

return


    (* the semantics of return is like an initialization
     * expression.
     *)
    (* stmt.return: a <<return>> without operand is allowed in functions
       returning cv <<void>>. *)
    Axiom wp_return_void : forall ρ Q,
        drop_qualifiers (get_return_type ρ) = Tvoid ->
        |> Q ReturnVoid |-- wp ρ (Sreturn None) Q.

    Axiom wp_return : forall ρ e (Q : Kpred),
          (let rty := get_return_type ρ in
           Forall p, wp_initialize ρ rty p e (fun frees =>
                                         interp frees (|> Q (ReturnVal p))))
       |-- wp ρ (Sreturn (Some e)) Q.

    Axiom wp_return_frame : forall ρ rv (Q Q' : Kpred),
        match rv with
        | None => Q ReturnVoid -* Q' ReturnVoid
        | Some _ =>
          (* NOTE unsound in the presence of exceptions *)
          Forall v, Q (ReturnVal v) -* Q' (ReturnVal v)
        end |-- wp ρ (Sreturn rv) Q -* wp ρ (Sreturn rv) Q'.

return x; where the copy or move from the automatic variable x may be elided (named return value optimization, <https://eel.is/c++draft/class.copy.elision1.1>): an implementation may construct [x] directly in the returned object, and then neither the constructor in [e] nor the destructor of [x] ever runs. The standard permits but does not require this (clang elides whenever [x] is the only candidate, at every optimization level), so the semantics is non-deterministic and a proof must cover both executions: - the copy or move runs, exactly as in [wp_return]; - the copy is elided: [x] is the returned object, and [Kfree] skips its destruction at scope exit (see [ReturnNRVO]). The elisions that C++17 guarantees (
    Axiom wp_return_nrvo : forall ρ x e (Q : Kpred),
          (let rty := get_return_type ρ in
           Forall p, wp_initialize ρ rty p e (fun frees =>
                                         interp frees (|> Q (ReturnVal p))))
          //\\ (|> Q (ReturnNRVO x (_local ρ x)))
       |-- wp ρ (Sreturn_nrvo x e) Q.

    Axiom wp_return_nrvo_frame : forall ρ x e (Q Q' : Kpred),
          (* NOTE unsound in the presence of exceptions *)
          (Forall v, Q (ReturnVal v) -* Q' (ReturnVal v))
          //\\ (Forall p, Q (ReturnNRVO x p) -* Q' (ReturnNRVO x p))
        |-- wp ρ (Sreturn_nrvo x e) Q -* wp ρ (Sreturn_nrvo x e) Q'.

break


    Axiom wp_break : forall ρ Q,
        |> Q Break |-- wp ρ Sbreak Q.
    Axiom wp_break_frame : forall ρ (Q Q' : Kpred),
        Q Break -* Q' Break |-- wp ρ Sbreak Q -* wp ρ Sbreak Q'.

continue

    Axiom wp_continue : forall ρ Q,
        |> Q Continue |-- wp ρ Scontinue Q.
    Axiom wp_continue_frame : forall ρ (Q Q' : Kpred),
        Q Continue -* Q' Continue |-- wp ρ Scontinue Q -* wp ρ Scontinue Q'.

goto and labels

goto l exits with Goto l; the enclosing blocks find the target (see Kblock and find_label).
    Axiom wp_goto : forall ρ l Q,
        |> Q (Goto l) |-- wp ρ (Sgoto l) Q.

A label has no effect when reached in sequence.
    Axiom wp_labeled : forall ρ l s Q,
        wp ρ s Q |-- wp ρ (Slabeled l s) Q.

switch


    (* compute the Prop that is known if this switch branch is taken *)
    Definition wp_switch_branch (s : SwitchBranch) (v : Z) : Prop :=
      match s with
      | Exact i => v = i
      | Range low high => low <= v <= high
      end%Z.

    Fixpoint get_cases (ls : list Stmt) : list SwitchBranch :=
      match ls with
      | Scase sb :: ls =>
        sb :: get_cases ls
      | _ :: ls => get_cases ls
      | nil => nil
      end.

    Definition default_from_cases (ls : list SwitchBranch) (v : Z) : Prop :=
      (fold_right (fun sb P => ~wp_switch_branch sb v /\ P) True ls).

apply the wp calculation to the body of a switch
NOTE that the semantics of switch statements is *very* conservative in the current setup. In particular.
1. We do not support using a case to jump over a variable declaration 2. We do not support case statements that jump into the bodies of loops, i.e. Duft's device.
Supporting 1 should not be difficult in principle. Full support for 2 seems to require a more sophisticated setup for wp. In other work, this sort of thing is handled as essentially unstructured programs.
We interpret the semantics of wp_switch_block by el
    Fixpoint wp_switch_block (Ldef : option (Z -> Prop)) (ls : list Stmt)
      : option (list ((Z -> Prop) * list Stmt)) :=
      match ls with
      | Scase sb :: ls =>
        (fun x => (wp_switch_branch sb, ls) :: x) <$> wp_switch_block Ldef ls
      | Sdefault :: ls =>
        match Ldef with
        | None =>
          (* NOTE in this case there were multiple default statements which is
             not legal *)
          None
        | Some def =>
          (fun x => (def, ls) :: x) <$> wp_switch_block None ls
        end
      | s :: ls' =>
        (* NOTE for a declaration, labeled or not, this check ensures that we
           never case past it, which could be problematic from a soundness
           point of view. *)
        if (if is_decl s then no_case (Sseq ls') else no_case s) then
          wp_switch_block Ldef ls'
        else
          None
      | nil =>
        match Ldef with
        | None => Some nil
        | Some def => Some ((def, nil) :: nil)
        end
      end.

    Definition Kswitch_inner (k : Kpred) (rt : ReturnType) : mpred :=
      match rt with
      | Break => k Normal
      | rt => k rt
      end.
    #[global] Arguments Kswitch_inner _ !rt /.

    Definition Kswitch (k : Kpred) : Kpred :=
      KP $ Kswitch_inner k.

    Lemma Kswitch_idemp Q :
      Kswitch (Kswitch Q) -|- Kswitch Q.
    Proof. by constructor => -[]. Qed.

    Lemma fupd_Kswitch Q :
      (|={⊤}=> Kswitch Q)
     -|- Kswitch (|={⊤}=> Q).
    Proof.
      by constructor; case => /= *;
         rewrite !monPred_at_fupd /=.
    Qed.

    (* An error to say that a `switch` block with body is not supported *)
    Record switch_block (body : list Stmt) : Prop := {}.

    Axiom wp_switch : forall ρ init decl e b Q,
        match pre_stmt init decl with
        | None =>
          match wp_switch_block (Some $ default_from_cases (get_cases b)) b with
          | None => UNSUPPORTED (switch_block b)
          | Some cases =>
            letI* v, free := wp_operand tu ρ e in
            interp free $
              Exists vv : Z, [| v = Vint vv |] **
              [∧list] x ∈ cases, [| x.1 vv |] -* wp_block ρ x.2 (Kswitch Q)
          end
        | Some ss =>
            wp ρ (Sseq (ss ++ [Sswitch None None e (Sseq b)])) Q
        end
        |-- wp ρ (Sswitch init decl e (Sseq b)) Q.

    (* note: case and default statements are only meaningful inside of switch.
     * this is handled by wp_switch_block.
     *)
    Axiom wp_case : forall ρ sb Q, Q Normal |-- wp ρ (Scase sb) Q.
    Axiom wp_default : forall ρ Q, Q Normal |-- wp ρ Sdefault Q.

  End with_resolver.

       like the !.
      Arguments wp_decl_var _ _ _ _ !_ _ /. *)
  #[global] Arguments wp_decl_var _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ /.
  #[global] Arguments wp_decl _ _ _ _ _ _ _ /. (* ! should occur on d *)

  Notation wp_for := wp_for_inv_nolater (only parsing).
  #[global,deprecated(since="20240204",note="use [wp_do_inv_nolater].")]
  Notation wp_do := wp_do_inv_nolater (only parsing).
  #[global,deprecated(since="20240204",note="use [wp_while_inv_nolater].")]
  Notation wp_while := wp_while_inv_nolater (only parsing).
